name: Omniscient
overview: The Scriptures reveal God's omniscience as His perfect and complete knowledge of all things, past, present, and future. He intimately knows His people, as David acknowledges in Psalms 139, and nothing can escape His presence or understanding. God declares the end from the beginning, showing His sovereign control over history and His unchanging counsel, while Jesus demonstrates divine insight by discerning human thoughts. This comprehensive knowledge assures believers that God fully understands their needs even before they ask.
